name: Database Query Mode Guard
summary: Block mutating SQL sent directly to database command and connector tools.
description: Extracts bounded SQL from recognized CLI flags or structured query fields, masks comments and literals, and permits only read-oriented statement forms at a live execution boundary.
refuses: It does not inspect migration files or database schema changes.
It does not connect to a database or execute EXPLAIN.
It does not treat stored procedures as read-only without an explicit static contract.

entrypoints.purpose: Block mutating SQL sent directly to database command and connector tools.
